content.title: FANATICS FLAG FOOTBALL CLASSIC | OBB Media
content.text: SPORTS EVENT | FOX SPORTS & TUBI | MARCH 2026EXECUTIVE PRODUCERS: MICHAEL RATNER, SCOTT RATNER, KFIR GOLDBERG, CAMILLE MARATCHI, GLENN STICKLEYTom Brady, Fanatics, FOX Sports and OBB Media teamed up to deliver a groundbreaking global flag football event on Saturday, March 21, 2026, at BMO Stadium in Los Angeles.The newly structured, first-of-its-kind competition included three 12-player teams: two comprised of an incredible mix of current and former NFL stars and elite global athletes, and a third represented by USA Football’s reigning IFAF Flag Football World Champion U.S. Men’s National Team, setting up a world-class showdown between many of the biggest names in sports and the most accomplished flag players in the world.Players included some of the biggest names in football, including Saquon Barkley, Stefon Diggs, Davante Adams, Odell Beckham Jr., and Rob Gronkowski. Founders FFC were captained by Tom Brady and Jalen Hurts and coached by Sean Payton. Wildcats FFC were captained by Jayden Daniels and Joe Burrow and coached by Kyle Shanahan.The event aired live on FOX Sports and Tubi, with award-winning actor and comedian Kevin Hart serving as host. The Fanatics Flag Football Classic was produced by OBB Media and Fanatics in association with Shadow Lion, with the telecast handled by FOX Sports.
